verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Batch processing of audio files and Realtime streaming, but nothing shows the service accepting a public or signed URL and fetching the recording itself. URL-based ingestion is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a public or signed URL and the service fetches and transcribes the recording without my uploading it
